sentence: This project studies which viral genes drive the loss of nerve projections into the eye during herpes simplex virus infection in mouse models.
This project combines tools for spatial multi-omics data with simulation software to help scientists learn the rules of cell interactions in cancer.
This project builds methods that use long-read sequencing to find genetic changes in cancer cells.
This project studies a mutation in an actin protein that normally causes skeletal muscle disease but here causes cardiomyopathy.
This project studies how motor cortex regions of the brain help produce repetitive behaviors and thought patterns.
This project builds a fiber implant to image the deep brain and study vascular dysfunction and memory loss in mouse models of Alzheimer disease.
This project develops a small molecule that turns on immune signaling to boost responses to an influenza vaccine, testing it in human cells and animals.
This project studies how immune signaling at the blood-brain barrier works during neuroinflammation, using animal models of disease and human tissue.
This project studies how nickel exposure leads to lung diseases, including cancer, by disrupting transcriptional regulation.
This project builds methods and capabilities for radiochemical, microbiological and chemical testing of food for defense and emergency response.
This project builds AI classifiers that use gut microbiome signals to tell apart stages of colorectal cancer, then tests them on stool and blood.
This project studies the brain circuits that cause breathing to stop after a seizure and lead to sudden death in epilepsy, using mouse models.
This project measures proteins, gene expression and chromatin modifications in samples from infected patients, mice and cells to find drivers of coronavirus infection.
This project builds a portable diagnostic system that uses microfabricated sensors for differential scanning calorimetry to tell types of heart attack apart.
This project studies liver cells grown from stem cells to find genes that raise the risk of fatty liver disease in Hispanics.
This project tests whether functional brain images taken at rest can predict how patients with epilepsy respond to surgery.
This project tries to find out the chemical and molecular steps by which mitochondrial DNA is broken down.
This project studies biologic pathways in lung cancer and tests therapeutic approaches that interfere with lung cancer progression and metastasis.
This project tests whether activating a protein can suppress memory T cells that resist belatacept and cause rejection after transplantation.
